limitations: Teacher-forced verification is not free-running MTP equivalence.
All native/fixed flags and invalid results are retained below. No valid inference-performance or universal non-regression claim.
Matching empty-content SHA256 values do not establish meaningful continuation equivalence; full-logit and independent-import equality are separate evidence.
Failed HTTP assertions remain failed; matching counts do not imply identical responses.
No complete-model runtime on M3; CPU-only M3 evidence is separate. No floor changes.
